The exam

ExamABII Certified Imaging Informatics Professional
CodeCIIP
QuestionsUp to 170
Time170 minutes
PassingABII reports a scaled score from 1 to 99 and 75 passes; the scale is not a percentage of questions correct. This course's official-format test asks for 75%.
Lessons65 lessons across 10 units, about 10.8 hours of reading

How the course works

  1. Cheat sheet. Everything the exam expects you to recall cold, printable.
  2. Starter test. A few questions per exam domain, with a confidence rating on each.
  3. Your tutorial. Lessons chosen from what you missed or guessed, each with a checkpoint and a deeper explanation.
  4. Practice tests and retraining. 50 questions, weighted like the real exam. Every miss is explained and feeds back into your lessons.
  5. 3 of your last 5 at 80%. That unlocks one full-length test on the real exam's clock: 170 questions in 170 minutes, at its real passing score of 75%. Pass it once and you are ready to book.

The first 15 lessons are open to read here. Every lesson, with its checkpoint, is free inside the course.

On exam day

  • 170 questions in 2 hours 50 minutes, about a minute each, with an on-screen calculator. Another 20 minutes cover the tutorial, the agreement, and a survey.
  • 40 of the questions are unscored pilot items and you cannot tell which. A question from nowhere may be one of them; answer it and move on.
  • You must answer each question before the next appears. Flag the doubtful ones and come back; never leave one blank.
  • Read for the qualifier: FIRST, MOST likely, BEST. The informatics answer usually protects patient identity and data integrity first, then restores service, then documents.
  • Know the arithmetic cold: study size, annual storage, compression ratio, transfer time in bits, and downtime from an availability percentage.
  • Pearson VUE center or online proctor, any day. Bring the ID the confirmation names and arrive early.
